scopeDecision.requiredBehavior: Registered stop failure is surfaced with retained-root cause, no unhandled rejection, genuine held child not falsely marked closed, root stays retained after later real child close. Per assigned acceptance, simultaneous body rejection is not a required trigger.
scopeDecision.changedScenario: OWN-STOP-FAILURE now has a successfully settled body and real registered stop rejection. This changes an authored test scenario and removes its simultaneous-body-error oracle; it must not be described as all original oracles unchanged.
scopeDecision.whyAcceptable: The actual required stop rejection and all retention/cause/close/unhandled oracles remain. The old scenario only exposed the primary body failure through genuine Node reporter, so treating that as the stop-cause proof would be false. Isolating stop failure lets the same real runner publicly expose the exact required failure chain without replacing runner, faking errors or weakening retention.
scopeDecision.notProved: Public dual-error reporting or simultaneous body+stop rejection behavior remains unproven; preserved prior failure must remain historical failed evidence. No blanket claim of arbitrary multi-failure diagnostics is approved.

sourceChecks: Actual stop method still throws OWN_STOP_SENTINEL while owning same live held child.
Outer assertions still demand FILES_RETAINED.cause == SHUTDOWN_FAILED and nested OWN_STOP_SENTINEL, plus successful-body event and absence of body-rejecting event.
Root must exist before release and after actual child close; real code0/signalnull close and absence of uncaught/unhandled remain required.
Other timeout-clean and disposal-timeout-late scenarios, watchdogs, original test deadlines, helper source, IPC barriers and termination-generation checks unchanged.
Retained observed evidence shows only OWN_BODY_SENTINEL in Node failure reporter and actual stop-entered/child-stop-requested events; no stop-cause acceptance can be inferred from it.
requiredBeforeAcceptance: Execute all3 ownership cases under exact source binding, original timeouts and strict unhandled rejection mode.
Inspect public real cause chain/retention/close oracles; nonzero nested exit alone is insufficient.
Update current matrix/implementation status to reference this explicit scenario decision; do not relabel V1/V2 failed simultaneous scenario as passed.
